card.name: Partway through split words and numbers
card.fires_on: Marked piece sits partway through a word or number that is split into parts, such as a digit inside 47-hour or 15-cent, depr in deprive, cro in sharecroppers, or -l in 300-lb.

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a number before a unit such as hour or cent.

modes.label: Start of split word
modes.description: The opening piece of a longer word like deprive or sharecropper.
modes.example: harmful treatment that<< depr>>ives them of their basic civil rights.

modes.label: Unit piece after number
modes.description: The -l piece of lb after a number such as 300.
modes.example: A 300<<-l>>b load can be raised by a pull

card.writes: It slightly favors gap-like tokens (Gap, Diff, cap), but the effect looks weak and unrelated to the contexts.
card.plain: It fires on the first pieces of words or numbers that the model has split up, where the rest is still to come.
